snippet.title: Of Peaks and Tides|Official Announcement Trailer|Reclaim
snippet.description:
In an age when deities and mortals coexisted in harmony, your ancestors built a resplendent civilization. Then came the celestial war between divinity and mortals. Deities left their creations devastated on the burning Everland. Storms and plagues tore across the lands.
You awaken among the remnants of lost tribes. Guided by ancient echoes, you and your companions will explore the broken world, reclaim your homeland, and reshape the fate of your people.
Coming to #gamescom2025 with a hands-on demo. Of Peaks and Tides brings a world where every move matters — get ready.
Official website: http://www.cyancook.com/
Steam: https://store.steampowered.com/app/3757140/?utm_source=youtube&utm_medium=social&utm_campaign=announcement
